paper_title: Token-Level Uncertainty Estimation for Large Language Model Reasoning
caption: Left: Uncertainty estimations in different token decoding temperature . Right: Influence of token decoding temperature on uncertainty-based AUROC scores.
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the behavior of three uncertainty estimation metrics—AU (red line with circular markers), TU (blue line with circular markers), and EU (green line with circular markers)—as a function of decoding temperature, which ranges from 0.0 to 0.8 on the linear x-axis. The y-axis, labeled with values from 0.000 to 0.175, represents the magnitude of the uncertainty estimates. The AU and TU lines exhibit nearly identical trends: they remain relatively flat between decoding temperatures of 0.0 and 0.4 (hovering around 0.125), then rise steadily from 0.4 to 0.6 (reaching approximately 0.140), and climb sharply from 0.6 to 0.8 (reaching about 0.180). In contrast, the EU line remains constant near 0.000 across the entire temperature range, showing no discernible variation with changes in decoding temperature. The plot includes a grid and a legend in the upper left corner identifying each line by its label and color.
